source: actual official silver and paired coverage manifest

metrics.scope: official systematic sample, not city totals

comparison.reason: Both equal-length windows must have complete selected-sample extraction on every day
comparison.method: Immediately preceding equal-length local calendar window, with identical category filters

trend.method: First 7 versus last 7 covered local calendar days

insights.title: Selected cohort
insights.body: 8,813 downloaded systematic sample requests were created from 2025-01-01 through 2025-03-31 (NYC local dates). Mean = 97.9 requests per covered day (90/90 days covered). The selected calendar is fully covered for this sample.

insights.title: Movement inside this window
insights.body: First 7 versus last 7 covered local calendar days: 918 requests (2025-01-01–2025-01-07) versus 627 (2025-03-25–2025-03-31), -31.7%. Each block has 7 complete calendar days and at least 20 requests. This is a descriptive sample contrast, not an annual seasonal pattern or causal effect.

insights.title: Busiest covered day
insights.body: 2025-01-07 recorded 155 selected sample arrivals (1 day(s) tied for this maximum). This can identify periods to investigate; it is not an anomaly test or a measure of service capacity.

insights.title: Agency mix
insights.body: NYPD accounts for 3,891 requests (44.2%) in the selected cohort. This identifies where sampled arrivals concentrate; agencies handle different complaint mixes and request difficulty, so shares are not staff-performance rankings.

insights.title: Resolution follow-up
insights.body: 270/8,813 requests (3.1%) have no observed closure by the fixed cutoff 2025-07-01T00:00:00+00:00. They are right-censored at that cutoff. This is follow-up for the selected creation cohort, not the city's current backlog.

insights.title: How to use this view
insights.body: Use date and category filters to inspect the same sample consistently. Counts are not city totals; systematic ID-suffix sampling may be biased. Missing days are gaps, edge weeks/months are labelled partial, and snapshot category fields may have been updated after creation. A short available history cannot establish year-round seasonality or staffing effects.
